name: Setup Deno
description: Setup Deno by installing, downloading, and adding it to the path.

deno-version.description: The Deno version to install. Can be a semver version of a stable release, "canary" for the latest canary, "lts" for the latest LTS, or the Git hash of a specifi

deno-version-file.description: File containing the Deno version to install such as .dvmrc or .tool-versions.

deno-binary-name.description: The name to use for the binary.

cache.description: Cache downloaded modules & packages automatically in GitHub Actions cache.

cache-hash.description: A hash used as part of the cache key, which defaults to a hash of the deno.lock files.
